description:
i7OS is a workspace for creative agencies: projects, tasks, documents, brand
profiles and moodboards in one place.

Connect it and your assistant can read from it and write back. Ask what is due
in your kanban this week, look up what your brand sounds like before drafting a
post, pull the colours from a moodboard, or search your documents by what they
mean rather than by the words they happen to contain.

It can also create tasks and notes, write documents, save an image you
generated, and publish a post to the social channels your workspace has
connected.

You see exactly what you see in the app and nothing more: a document set to
private stays private, and a workspace you are not a member of stays invisible.
Writing only happens when you ask for it.

defaultPrompt: What's on my i7OS board this week?
What's our brand tone of voice in i7OS? Draft three post options that fit it.
Create a task in i7OS: write the client proposal, due Friday, high priority.
